cves.description: Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') in VM Inspector for Azure Virtual Machines allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Microsoft VM Inspector for Azure Virtual Machines
🔓 漏洞类型：CWE-59 (CWE-59)
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
